title: City Day
description: Given the forecasted rainfall a_i over n days (distinct values), find the earliest day d such that the rainfall on day d is strictly less than that of each of the previous x days and each of the following y days.
input_format: First line: n, x, y. Second line: n distinct integers a_i — rain amounts.
output_format: Print a single integer — the 1-based index of the earliest "not-so-rainy" day.
expected_approach: For each day d from 1 to n, check the previous x days and next y days to see if all their rain amounts are greater than a[d]; output the first day satisfying this.

test_cases.explanation: Day 3 (rain=6) is less than days 1–2 and 4–5.
Day 3 fails the > following y=3 days test; day 8 (rain=1) passes.
On day 5 (rain=10), the ranges extend beyond bounds, and it’s the smallest.
